stem.en: A program looks at a picture of a ball and writes down 3 numbers: 24, 40 and 11. What is this program doing?

text.en: Decoding, because it reads the picture carefully.
Encoding, because it squeezes pixels into latent numbers.
Decoding, because latent numbers come out at the end.
Encoding, because it draws the ball from its numbers.

explanation.en: A picture going in and a few numbers coming out is an encoder. A decoder runs the other way, from latent numbers out to pixels, so drawing from numbers is decoding, not encoding. Reading carefully does not make it decoding: what matters is the direction.

hints.en: Ask what goes in and what comes out.
